timing.note: feas_frac = M_feas / E_np: the share of an occupation's exposed, non-physical, permissible activity time that the capability path covers, averaged over the window; tests whether capability timing adds to exposure restricted to non-physical, permissible work

rho_sweep.note: main specification (Table backtest-occ, panel A) re-estimated at each rho_rev; thresholds interpolate linearly between grid points

notes: mix_M is the cost-weighted mean over the firm's four cost buckets of the model's bucket automatable share; bucket shares are wage-bill-weighted function scores, with function to occupation weights from function_occ_by_industry.csv for SIC 7371-7374 and function_occ.csv for SIC 7370, and the within-bucket function splits of industry_function_shares.csv (assumed).

sample.filters: SIC 7370-7374; revenue >= $10M in the pre window; COGS (revenue - gross profit), S&M, G&A and R&D each reported and between 0 and 2 of revenue in both windows; changes in percentage points of revenue winsorized at 2.5/97.5 percentiles

joint_loses_5pct.status: not significant at the low end of the range

cells.design: Delta log employment of occupation x industry cells, May 2021 to May 2025. Industry fixed effects (and SOC major groups) for the exposure and model scores; occupation and industry fixed effects for the wage-driven model score, whose only within-occupation variation is the cell's May 2021 wage in the cost crossover. Standard errors clustered two-way by occupation and industry. Controls: physical task share, job zone and log cell wage (the log cell wage alone within occupation).
cells.harmonization: NAICS 2017 to 2022 at four digits: common codes kept (renamed titles only); 5111->5131 and 5112->5132; 5151, 5152 and 5191 combined with 5161, 5162 and 5192; retail trade at the sector level (44-45).
